content_variants.text:
Military escalation | Two women injured in an attack by H*T*S on two villages in Hama

“Luwaa Uthman Ibn Affan” which is one of the formations of HTS targeted positions of the regime in Jurin and Na’orat Jurin Villages in north western Hama countryside with missiles and artillery shells within “Putin-Erdogan” area, causing the injury of two women and they were taken to the hospital to receive proper medication.

Since early 2023, SOHR has documented 223 operations in the “de-escalation zone,” including attacks, gunfire by snipers and bombardment, which left 312 combatants and civilians dead. In addition, these operations left over 165 combatants and 72 civilians, including 11 women and 22 children, injured.
The fatalities can be distributed as follows:
• 23 civilians, including four women, five children and a civil defence member, were killed by regime forces.
• 217 members of regime forces, including 14 officers.
• An Afghan militiaman of “Liwaa Fatemiyoun.”
• A member of the Syrian Hezbollah.
• 59 members of Hayyaat Tahrir Al-Sham, including a French jihadist.
• Three members of the jihadist faction of “Ansar Al-Tawheed.
• One member of “Ahrar Al-Sham” movement.
• Two members of “Al-Sham Corps.”
• One member of “Hurras Al-Din” organisation.
• The Commander-in-chief of Russian Special Tasks Forces.
• A militiaman of the Iranian-backed “Liwaa Al-Baqer.”
• A member of “Soqour Al-Sham.”
• A member of the “National Liberation Front.
